items.title: Holman Bill — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: Were these all your contemporaries from high school?

Yeah. Then I graduated. I was going to go into the Navy. So I forgot about music for a while. I wanted to get in the Navy officer training program called V12 Program, where they sent you to school – to a college. You took part civilian courses and part Navy courses. At the end of it, you went to office training school for three months and you got a commission. That‟s what I went into. Naturally, there was no music involved in that.
